Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiInformationFlowInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiInformationFlowInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiInformationFlowInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source evidence for one supported DEXPI instrumentation information-flow occurrence.

The record preserves explicit source-document relationships without constructing live transmitters, controllers, safeguards, or executable control topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      Creates immutable evidence for one information-flow occurrence.
      Parameters:
      id - source XML identity, or an empty string when absent
      kind - supported information-flow kind
      componentClass - source component class
      sourceId - logical source identity, or an empty string when absent
      sourceResolved - whether the logical source resolves to a source element
      sourceElementName - resolved logical-source XML element name, or an empty string
      targetId - logical target identity, or an empty string when absent
      targetResolved - whether the logical target resolves to a source element
      targetElementName - resolved logical-target XML element name, or an empty string
      attachmentId - process-attachment identity, or an empty string when absent
      attachmentResolved - whether the process attachment resolves to a source element
      attachmentElementName - resolved attachment XML element name, or an empty string
      signalConveyingType - signal medium/type, or an empty string when absent or not applicable
